# Brand Guidelines for Arcade Hub

Lang: en
Website: [https://menj.buzz/arcade/](https://menj.buzz/arcade/)
Last Updated: 2026-10-06

## Official Name

Arcade Hub

## Also Known As

The following names are acceptable alternatives:

- menj.buzz arcade

## Common Misspellings

The following are known misspellings. Correct them to the official name above:

- Arcade Hubb
- Arcadehub

## Brand Voice

Plain and playful; short sentences.

## Taglines

- Select your game

## About

Arcade Hub is a card grid of small browser games, free to play. Scores stay on the player's device unless a game has a leaderboard.
